changelog: Ladder refill applied for architectural consistency — the same correctness fix shipped to Growth v5.3: weight freed by a concentration trim goes to the next eligible, correlation-screened name before flowing down to bonds; flow-down becomes the exhaustion path. Preserve's defensive weight is mostly CHOSEN rather than blocked (26.87% held, of which the ladder recovers only ~1.7pp), so the effect here is small and the principle correctly leaves the deliberate bond allocation alone. Measured: CAGR 13.87->13.70%, Martin 3.091->2.929, sCopley 1.706->1.638, cvar3m -8.13->-8.36%, worst-12mo -6.35->-6.60%, RDD3y 0.028->0.024, start-cohorts-behind 6.85->6.33%. NOT a tuned release — Preserve's parameters were fitted around the old cascade and this champion is due a retune against the corrected architecture. Shipped now for consistency so both models share one overflow contract; the retune is the next piece of work on this model.
